description: Testimonies from released women describe strip searches, threats, sleep deprivation and severe overcrowding, with some sleeping on the floor. Data from Palestinian monitoring bodies indicates 88 women held in Damon prison under difficult humanitarian and health conditions.

aspect: EXAMPLE - eight days, no shower, no pads
description: One woman described being moved between prisons, subjected to repeated strip searches and interrogations at gunpoint, and during eight days at an unknown facility having no access to a shower, menstrual pads or toiletries.

aspect: The strip search is used as a routine, not an exception
description: Repeated searches on transfer, on return from court, before and after visits. Frequency converts a security procedure into something else.
energy_note: Searched so often it stops being about finding anything.

description: The Palestinian Prisoner's Society notes a longstanding policy of targeting university students, particularly women - four Birzeit students were arrested in overnight raids in a single operation.

aspect: Release is not the end of it
description: A former female detainee carries a social cost on return - questions about what happened in custody, effects on marriage prospects, and a reluctance in the community to ask or be told. The silence protects nobody.
energy_note: Out of prison, into everyone's imagination.
